questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a rule for using turn signals?

options.text: Keep your signal on the whole time you are turning.
Turn off your signal after you finish turning or changing lanes.
Only signal if another vehicle is nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only signal if another vehicle is nearby.
questions.explanation: Always signal before you turn or change lanes. Signal well in advance and keep it on during the turn. After you finish turning or changing lanes, turn off your signal if it does not turn off by itself.

questions.question: If you need to stop quickly while carrying liquids, what is one safe option?

options.text: Turn the wheel while you brake.

questions.explanation: When you need to stop quickly to avoid a crash while carrying liquids, use the stab braking method. Do not turn the wheel while braking. This can cause your vehicle to tip over, especially if it sits high off the ground.

questions.question: When you check the engine, what should you NOT do?

options.text: Check the windshield washer fluid level.

questions.explanation: When you check the engine, you should look at the oil level, coolant level, and windshield washer fluid level. You should never drain the brake fluid.

questions.question: Class 1, Class 2.1, and Class 3 materials should NOT be placed in a trailer with:
questions.explanation: Cargo heaters are not always allowed. You cannot use heaters when transporting Class 1 (Explosives), Class 2.1 (Flammable Gas), or Class 3 (Flammable Liquids) materials.

questions.question: If oil and water build up in your air tanks, the brakes:

options.text: Will make a loud squealing noise.

questions.explanation: You should drain your air tanks daily to remove water and oil. If too much oil and water build up in the air tanks, your brakes will not work correctly.

questions.question: To prevent a surge when a tank is stopping, brakes should:

options.text: Not be released too fast after you stop.
Be pressed hard and then released.
Be used with the parking brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not be released too fast after you stop.
questions.explanation: To reduce front-to-back surge when stopping a tank vehicle, keep steady pressure on the brakes. Do not let off them too quickly after you stop.

questions.question: What sign might tell you that a shipment has hazardous materials?

options.text: The company shipping it normally deals with hazardous materials.
Your last shipment from this company was labeled hazardous.

questions.correctAnswerText: The company shipping it normally deals with hazardous materials.
questions.explanation: One sign that a shipment may have hazardous materials is when the company is in a business that deals with them. Examples include paint stores, chemical suppliers, science supply shops, pest control companies, farm suppliers, and companies that deal with explosives, fireworks, or ammunition.

questions.question: Multi-speed axles and auxiliary transmissions are used to:

options.text: Make a vehicle run more smoothly.

questions.explanation: Many vehicles use multi-speed rear axles and auxiliary transmissions to provide extra gears. They are usually controlled by a selector knob on the gearshift lever.

questions.question: If someone is tailgating you, what should you do?
questions.explanation: If someone is tailgating you, create more space in front of your vehicle so they can pass safely. Driving faster will not help because the driver may continue to tailgate you at the higher speed, making it more dangerous.

questions.question: If you think the road might be icy, you can:

options.text: Open the window and feel the front of your mirror for ice.

questions.correctAnswerText: Open the window and feel the front of your mirror for ice.
questions.explanation: If you think the road might be icy, open the window and feel the front of your side mirror, mirror support, or antenna. If ice has formed on these parts, the road is probably icy too.

questions.question: When should you turn off your turn signal while making a turn?
questions.explanation: Signal early and keep your signal on during the entire turn or lane change. Turn off your signal once you have completed the turn or lane change.

questions.question: Before loading or unloading flammable liquids, the engine must be:
questions.explanation: Turn off the engine before loading or unloading flammable liquids. The only exception is if the engine must run to operate a pump.

questions.question: Which one is NOT a sign of damaged brakes?

options.text: Brake shoes with oil or grease on them
Brake pads clean and free of oil or grease

questions.correctAnswerText: Brake pads clean and free of oil or grease
questions.explanation: Signs of brake damage include cracked drums, brake shoes or pads with oil, grease, or brake fluid on them, and shoes that are missing, broken, or worn too thin. Clean pads without oil or grease are a sign of good brakes.

questions.question: If you are not sure your vehicle will fit under a bridge, you should:

options.text: Swerve as you pass under it

questions.explanation: If you are not sure your vehicle will safely pass under an overhead object, slow down and find another route if possible.

questions.question: Emergency air lines are usually marked with which color?
questions.explanation: Service air lines are marked blue. Emergency air lines are marked red.

questions.question: When driving through a work zone, what should you do?

options.text: Steer with one hand to keep the other hand free

questions.explanation: In work zones, follow posted speed limits. Slow down if road or weather conditions are poor, and slow down even more if workers are near the road.

questions.question: Which type of cargo is hardest to transport because its weight shifts?
questions.explanation: Liquids in a partially-filled tank are dangerous because they move and surge while driving. This liquid surge causes the vehicle's weight to shift.

questions.question: When you start a truck with a trailer, how do you know if the Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) is broken?

options.text: The yellow light on the back of the trailer stays on
The red light on the trailer flashes three times and then stays on
All rear lights on the trailer flash and then shut off
The blue light near the driver's door turns on

questions.correctAnswerText: The yellow light on the back of the trailer stays on
questions.explanation: Trailers with Anti-Lock Braking Systems have a yellow warning light on the back left side. If this light stays on after the engine starts, the ABS is not working.

questions.question: How is alcohol removed from the body?

options.text: At different rates depending on how much alcohol is in the body
At the same rate no matter how much alcohol is in the body
Faster if the person drinks coffee
Faster if the person stays awake

questions.correctAnswerText: At the same rate no matter how much alcohol is in the body
questions.explanation: The liver removes alcohol at a fixed, constant rate. You cannot speed this up by drinking coffee or taking a cold shower. The only way to sober up is to give your body time to process the alcohol.

questions.question: How far away must a person stay before smoking near a vehicle carrying Class 3 or Division 2.1 hazardous materials?
questions.explanation: Do not smoke within 25 feet of a vehicle carrying Class 3 or Division 2.1 hazardous materials.
